List of Lexibyte Codenames

This article shows a list of codenames used by Lexibyte in their projects.

A · B · D · H· K · L · M · N · O · Q · R · S · W · Z

A

Arctic

Codename for Lexibyte Arctic, also see LeafyOS and Lexibyte Arctic.

Atheros

Another suggested codename for Lexibyte Arctic, later scrapped due to the name being of a real company now owned by Qualcomm.

It was the first name that went to my mind and I thought it was a cool name to use, eventually I scrapped it due to copyright issues with Qualcomm, as they own Atheros Communications, my Atheros and the network card company are not related in any way.

- Lexibyte

Atsura

Preliminary name for the final product of the merge between Horicraft (1) and Horicraft (2).

B

Better Late than Never

StuffyXP Website Update 2.1, referencing that the update was delayed multiple times due to Lexibyte not having a PC to work on the update.

D

DogUI

Suggested name for the user interface component in Lexibyte Arctic, also referencing Lexibyte’s dog plushie, Dogui.

H

Happy New Year!

StuffyXP Website Update 2.1.1, referencing that the update was released on New Years Eve, but was actually released on Christmas Eve (Dec 24).

K

Kanto

The original C++ Arctic Kernel.

Kanto32

The i386 re-write of the Kanto kernel, included with Arctic32

L

LeafyOS

Original name of Lexibyte Arctic.

M

Midori

Internal name for the Arctic bootloader and the name of the successor to both Horicraft and Horicraft (2).

MidoriMC

N

New Coat of Paint

StuffyXP Website Update 2.0.¹

O

One Last Fix

StuffyXP Website Update 2.1.2, the last update to StuffyXP Website after being replaced with HoriWebsite.

Q

Qattah

Stuffy’s Place.

R

ReKanto

The codename for the assembly rewrite of the Lexibyte Arctic kernel.

S

StuffyXP 2

Lexibyte Website Alpha. Not related to a spiritual sucessor to the StuffyXP Channel, which does not exist nor a public website codename.

W

Week One Update

Stuffy’s Website Update 1.1.

Note: Codenames for StuffyXPWebsite were introduced in this version before being scrapped in HoriWebsite, thus HoriWebsite & Stuffy Website 1.0 don’t have a codename.

Z

Zetta

Cancelled engine by Lexibyte that would later on merge to the HoriWiki engine.

¹↑ Referenced from the build file's commit history, see this for more info.
